sources.text: Requests may be retried for 24 hours. Duplicate receipts are retained for 48 hours. Replays must preserve the original booking identifier.

claims.statement: The retry window lasts one day.
claims.quote: Requests may be retried for 24 hours.

claims.statement: Duplicate receipts are retained for two days.
